# Glossary {#sec-glossary}

Terms for the distinctions this book keeps needing. Each one points at the
chapter that gives it a home. Popups in the text use the same definitions.

ALTREP

: A framework for giving an ordinary SEXPTYPE a different payload: a
  compact sequence, a deferred string, a mapped vector, a cached answer
  to "are you sorted?" See [the value illusion](04-value-illusion.qmd).

Condition

: A classed signal. Handlers can run while the stack is still live, or
  they can unwind. See [signals](06-signals.qmd).

Cons cell

: A heap node with a head (CAR), a tail (CDR), and an optional name (TAG).
  Pairlists and calls are chains of them, ending at Nil. See
  [cons and vectors](03-cons.qmd).

Copy-on-modify

: The rule that a shared ordinary vector is duplicated before a write, so
  other names keep the old value. See
  [the value illusion](04-value-illusion.qmd).

Functional core

: The part of a program that decides on values. The imperative shell
  around it is where effects, handles, and hosts live. See
  [where state lives](10-containers.qmd).

Generic vector

: R's user-facing list. One header plus a contiguous array of SEXP
  pointers. Type `VECSXP`. See [three empties](02-empties.qmd) and
  [cons and vectors](03-cons.qmd).

Immortal

: A node the collector must not free and the mutator must not modify. The
  reference count is pinned at `REFCNTMAX`, 65535. Nil is the canonical
  case. See [the header](01-header.qmd).

Open verb

: An operation that lives outside the type, so new nouns can join it and
  new verbs can be taught to old nouns. See [open verbs](09-open-verbs.qmd).

Promise

: A delayed argument: an expression, an environment, and eventually a
  value. Forced at most once. See
  [the value illusion](04-value-illusion.qmd).

Reference owner

: An object whose identity is part of the API. Aliases observe the same
  evolving state. See [where state lives](10-containers.qmd).

Restart

: A named way to resume from a condition at the point where it was
  signaled, if someone established one. See [signals](06-signals.qmd).

Ubiquitous language

: The curated names of a domain, shared by the code, the console, and the
  people working in it. See [the law](00-the-law.qmd) and
  [data drives the design](13-data-drives.qmd).

Value illusion

: The public story that ordinary R objects behave as values, sustained by
  sharing, reference counts, delayed copies, and sometimes by never
  allocating the payload at all. See
  [the value illusion](04-value-illusion.qmd).

View

: How a value is shown. A separate contract from what the value is. See
  [shown on purpose](12-appearance.qmd).
